newsitem.title: UK: Hambro Countrywide to offer conveyancing.
newsitem.headline: Hambro Countrywide to offer conveyancing.

text.p: Hambro Countrywide Plc, the estate agent chain 52 percent owned by investment bank Hambros Plc said on Tuesday it would offer legal conveyancing services to its customers from spring 1997.

The company said the legal services would be through an associated practice of licensed conveyancers and would be a natural addition to its existing services and speed and simplify the process of buying a house.
It aims to offer the services in most of its 727 residential estate agency offices within two years.
